label: scale-live-profiled-10
command: Use the spawn tool to start 10 sub-agents in parallel, all in your first reply, one per file: f1.txt f2.txt f3.txt f4.txt f5.txt f6.txt f7.txt f8.txt f9.txt f10.txt, all in this directory. Each sub-agent reads only its file and answers with that file's first line exactly. Do not read the files yourself. When every sub-agent has answered, print each first line on its own line.
method: a Windows job object holds the whole tree from its first instruction and posts each new member to a completion port, where it is opened at once and its handle kept to the end, so its final CPU time and its own peak working set are read even after it exits; its parent comes from its basic information and its command line from NtQueryInformationProcess; every 100 ms the live members' working sets are summed into tree RSS, a page shared by two processes counted in both
